study type: Retrospective case-control study and animal study
exposure: Prepregnancy glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonist (GLP-1RA) use
outcome: Ratio with first-trimester metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease
Phosphorylated to total fibroblast growth factor receptor 1 (FGFR1)
cohort: The study included 42 women with obesity of childbearing age and 60 virgin female Sprague Dawley rats fed either a normal or high-fat diet.
finding: Prepregnancy GLP-1RA use improves maternal lipid metabolism during pregnancy, potentially involving elevated liver-secreted FGF21.
